theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fc_tb_extend_univ_boundary
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U K : Set (Euclid P)) (A : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1)), IsOpen U → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity A.boundary → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) K → A ω = 0) → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Y.boundary ∧ Y.restrictDomain (subset_univ U) = A ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) (m + 1))) K → Y ω = 0) ∧ Y.mass ≤ A.mass ∧ Y.boundary.mass ≤ A.boundary.mass
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
